description: This line plot, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," illustrates the maximum activation value across different layers for four distinct components of a neural network model. The x-axis represents the "Layer," ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 5, indicating the layer index. The y-axis represents the "Max Activation Value," scaled linearly from 0 to 1600. The plot contains four lines: a blue dashed line with square markers for "attn_residual," an orange dotted line for "ffn_output," a green dashed line with square markers for "ffn_residual," and a red solid line with square markers for "ffn_residual." The "attn_residual" line remains near zero until layer 5, then sharply rises to a peak of approximately 1400 at layer 5 before declining slightly and stabilizing near 1600 through layer 22. The "ffn_output" line starts near zero, rises steeply to a peak of approximately 1400 at layer 5, then drops sharply to near zero by layer 10, before rising again to approximately 1200 at layer 22. The "ffn_residual" line remains near zero until layer 5, then rises to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains relatively stable until layer 20, and then declines to approximately 500 at layer 22. The "ffn_residual" line remains near zero throughout the entire range of layers shown.
